meta.source: NASA Open Science Data Repository (OSDR), Environmental Data Application (EDA) API
meta.aggregation: plain mean of the published samples in each UTC hour
meta.excluded: samples below 400 ppm and runs of one identical value lasting >= 6 h (placeholders from before the hardware was on station); dropped, not repaired
meta.conversion: mmHg = ppm x 760 / 1e6 (nominal ISS cabin pressure). A unit conversion; the values are not rescaled.

replay.note: The real trace is replayed on the simulated mission's calendar. Only the day labels change.

meta.dailyWindow: Each mission day covers the 24 h before the 08:00 UTC check-in; the mean needs at least 12 hours of data.
meta.caveat: The series is the ISS-side environmental telemetry published for the Rodent Research 7 payload. It is real ISS data, but it comes from that payload's sensor location and may differ from a cabin-wide average.
meta.limitSource: NASA-STD-3001 Vol 2 [V2 6004]: 1-hour average CO2 limited to 3 mmHg
